::: {.obsidian-letter}
:::

Open the letter with the purpose. Keep sentences under 25 words and
use the active voice, per the house writing standard.

Use the second paragraph for the detail. State what you are asking
for, when you need it, and why. A short letter reads better than a
long one.

Close with the action you expect and a date. Offer to answer any
questions.

::: {.obsidian-letter-closing}
:::
